_contract: #3864 — reply-delivery correlation. The content hash is the cross-language join key: chorus-hooks (Rust, reply.emitted at the Stop hook) and Clearing's session-tailer (TS, reply.rendered) must produce the IDENTICAL hash for the same reply, or emitted/rendered pairs never join and every reply looks like a delivery gap. The two sides read DIFFERENT bytes for the same reply — the Rust extractor joins text blocks with newline and keeps the chorus header; the tailer joins with spaces and strips it — so the rule canonicalizes BOTH to one form. Canonicalize: (1) strip one LEADING '--- ... ---' chorus header (dotall, first occurrence only), (2) collapse every whitespace run to a single space, (3) trim. Hash: sha256 of the canonical utf8, lowercase hex, first 16 chars. Nothing else — each additional normalization is a place for the two implementations to disagree (#3818's lesson).
